sentences.text:
Lakshmi @ Laxmi Mahakul vs Land Acquisition Zone on 13
March, 2024
 In The High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack
 L.A.A. No.33 of 2023
 Lakshmi @ Laxmi Mahakul .... Appellant
 Mr. S.K. Baral,
 Advocate
 -versus-
 Land Acquisition Zone .... Respondent
 Officer, Khurda Road
 Bolangir New B.G. Rail Link
 Project, Boudh
 Mr. B. Panigrahi,
 Additional Standing Counsel
 Coram: Justice Sanjay Kumar Mishra
 Order

entities.text: High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 05 . This matter is taken up through hybrid mode.

2. Though the matter is on board for consideration of I.A. No.86 of 2024, which has been filed for condonation of delay in preferring the Appeal, on perusal of the averments made in the I.A so also impugned judgment, it is found that vide the impugned judgment dated 15.02.2022 passed in LAR & R Case No. 11 of 2020, the Referral Court allowed the petition of the present Appellant and directed the Land Acquisition Zone Officer (Opposite Party before the Court below) to recalculate the value of the land under Section 26(1) of RFCTLAR&R Act, 2013 adopting all the three procedures prescribed under Section 26(1) of the Act, 2013 and after having valuation of the land,
calculate the amount of compensation as per the order dated 22.06.2018 of Government of Odisha and pay the differential amount to the Petitioner (Appellant herein) with interest as prescribed under the Act.

3. A query being made, learned Counsel for the Appellant submits, as per the instruction received,
on being so directed by the Referral Court, the Land Acquisition Zone Officer recalculated/
re-determined the compensation amount on 19th December, 2022, which was received by the present Appellant under protest on 9th March, 2023.
Hence, the said judgment impugned in the present Appeal has already been implemented/worked out.

4. The said recalculated/re-determined order of the Land Acquisition Zone Officer being a fresh cause of action, which is to be decided by the Referral Court under Section 64 of the Act, 2013, the Lakshmi @ Laxmi Mahakul vs Land Acquisition Zone on 13 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/183479649/

5. Accordingly, the Appeal stands dismissed as withdrawn, with liberty as prayed for.
(S. K. Mishra) Judge Prasant Signed by: PRASANT KUMAR PRADHAN Reason: Authentication Location: High Court of Orissa, Cuttack.
